operative_clauses: Sec. 39. EFFECTIVE DATE. Sections 1 to 38 are effective the day following final enactment.
signed_quote: Signed by the governor May 9, 2014, 10:28 a.m.
references.act_title: An act relating to natural resources; modifying disposition of certain land and revenue; adding to and deleting from state forests and recreation areas; authorizing public and private sales and exchanges of certain state lands; merging certain state parks; authorizing the purchase of a dam; amending Minnesota Statutes 2012, sections 89.022; 459.06, subdivision 1; 477A.17; Minnesota Statutes 2013 Supplement, section 85.012, subdivision 38a; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2012, section 85.012, subdivision 53a.
